description:
FILED s527g (2026-10-31).  tools/ppi-expect-check.pl (Pl/PPIExpect.pm) flags the now-correct Word tokens of a lexical sub named like a quote-like operator: t/op/lexsub.t 354 (`state sub q () { 45 } is q(), 45`), 745 (q), 851 (`is y, 43` after `my sub y`), t/op/lvref.t 642-644 (`s(1); s(2); is s(3), 1` after `my sub s`) -- quote-letter-as-word 0 -> 6 and paren-after-term +5, in raw and pcl modes alike.  perl reads each as a call (toke.c yyl_keylookup looks in the pad before the keyword table).  The checker is the same class as #3946 (a checker gap, not a PPI bug): it should model a `my`/`state`/`our sub NAME` declaration for the rest of its block, the way s527c taught it the dereference loop variable.  Measured: expect m0 (main 1885930f) vs m3 (s527g) by kind, scratch/s527g/expect-m{0,3}-raw.tsv in the s527g worktree.

=== DONE (s531e) ===
Pl/PPIExpect.pm (commit 882618aa): `_declared_words` records each `my` / `state` / `our sub NAME` with its enclosing block, and `_lexsub_in_scope` answers whether such a declaration precedes the token inside a block that holds it; the word handler then drops the keyword reading (yyl_keylookup looks in the pad before the keyword table) -- not under XOPERATOR, so `3 x 2` stays the repetition operator after `my sub x`.  Measured (all populations; BEFORE = the clone run at a376a6d8, old checker): this task's rows quote-letter-as-word 6 (t/op/lexsub.t q, t/op/lvref.t s) + paren-after-term 5 + missing-operand 6 (t/op/lexsub.t's `my $x = if if if;` after `my sub if`, the same mechanism) -> 0; raw 711 -> 680 / pcl 657 -> 626 together with #3946.  No kind rose.  Instrument only.
subject: the expect-state checker does not model LEXICAL SUBS: after PCL's PPI calls a keyword-named lexical sub by its bare name (§43, group AL) the call sites report quote-letter-as-word / paren-after-term (11 false rows)
